items.title: Create a centralized flow fact policy registry for process facts
items.context: Process facts that affect phase, review, test, DONE, finding/pass, evidence, branch/worktree, or cleanup must be represented in code as policy metadata rather than only prompt/docs text.

items.title: Enforce review fact schema and pass-only normalization in handlers
items.context: reviewRound doc/runtime drift and pass-only finding records should be mechanically normalized or rejected at the handler/schema boundary, not left to reviewer prompt behavior.

items.title: Make express verification policy explicit and machine-readable
items.context: Express stories intentionally bypass PLAN verificationIntent. That exemption should be a structured policy visible to validation/review outputs, not an implicit reviewer explanation.

items.title: Add regression tests for flow fact policy enforcement
items.context: Historical drift signals should be locked by smoke tests covering registry availability, reviewRound normalization, pass-only finding behavior, and express verification policy.
